description:
Formula Fanatics is an e-commerce store created by Formula 1 enthusiasts for fellow fans. Our mission is to provide unique, high-quality apparel and accessories that capture the excitement and passion of Formula 1. From race schedule calendars to stylish, fan-inspired merchandise, our products are designed to keep fans connected to the sport they love.

Our flagship product is the 2025 Formula 1 Race Schedule Calendar, a fan-favorite desk and wall calendar that highlights every Grand Prix weekend, sprint races, and even Formula 1 driver birthdays. Each month features inspiring quotes from legendary drivers and stunning Formula 1-themed artwork. Beyond calendars, we offer apparel, accessories, and gifts that blend style with fandom, making them perfect for F1 enthusiasts worldwide.

Why Fans Love it:

  • Fan-Centric Design: Every product is designed with Formula 1 fans in mind, blending functionality with the thrill of the sport.
  • Exclusive Features: Our race schedule calendar is one-of-a-kind, providing not just dates but also track facts and driver-related insights.
  • Global Appeal: Our products resonate with F1 fans of all ages and from all corners of the world.
  • High Quality: We pride ourselves on delivering premium products that fans love and trust.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission Structure: Affiliates earn a competitive 15% commission on every sale driven through their unique discount code or referral link.
  • Payout Frequency: Payments are made monthly via Paypal, provided a minimum threshold of $10is met.
term_and_condition:
Formula Fanatics Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Welcome to the Formula Fanatics Affiliate Program. By participating in our program, you agree to the terms and conditions outlined below. Please review them carefully before proceeding.

1. Eligibility

  • Affiliates must be at least 18 years old to join the program.

  • Residency eligibility is at the discretion of Formula Fanatics.

  • Both individuals and businesses are eligible to participate.

2. Sign-Up Process

  • To join, affiliates must complete the sign-up form with their name, email address, and contact information.

  • All applications are manually reviewed, and approval is communicated within 5 business days via email.

  • Upon approval, affiliates will receive further information and access to their tools.

3. Affiliate Tools

  • Approved affiliates will receive referral links and discount codes to share with their audience.

  • Restrictions:

    • Referral links and discount codes may not be used for self-referrals.

    • Affiliates are prohibited from uploading discount codes to mass coupon sites (e.g., coupons.com, retailmenot).

    • Links and codes must be used responsibly and within the guidelines provided by Formula Fanatics.

4. Earnings and Payments

Commission Details:

  • Affiliates earn a standard commission rate of 15% on referral sales (excluding tax and shipping costs).

  • Periodic bonus opportunities will be communicated via email.

Payout Schedule:

  • Minimum payout threshold: $10.

  • Payments are made via PayPal by the 5th business day of the month following the previous month’s activity.

  • Affiliates are responsible for covering PayPal fees, tax fees, and any other applicable charges.

Refunds and Chargebacks:

  • If an order is returned, canceled, or results in a chargeback, a negative referral record will be created to offset the commission earned from that order.

5. Affiliate Conduct

Permitted Promotion Channels:

  • Affiliates may promote on social media, websites, email, and other approved channels.

  • Paid ads targeting brand keywords are strictly prohibited.

Prohibited Practices:

  • The following are not allowed and may result in removal from the program:

    • Spam, false advertising, or misrepresentation.

    • Any actions not aligned with the core values of Formula Fanatics.

Brand Representation:

  • Formula Fanatics is not associated with Formula 1, F1, Grand Prix, Formula One trademarks, logos, or copyrights. Affiliates must refrain from using these terms in their marketing.

6. Fraud Prevention and Termination

Fraud Monitoring:

  • Fraudulent behavior includes but is not limited to:

    • Suspicious Activity: Unusually high orders from the same IP address or geographic location.

    • Self-Referrals: Using your affiliate link or discount code for personal purchases.

    • Fake Orders: Generating orders with false information, such as fake names, addresses, or payment details.

  • Affiliates engaging in fraudulent activity will be removed and forfeit any unpaid commissions.

Termination Policy:

  • Affiliates may be terminated without notice for violating these terms or engaging in fraudulent or prohibited activities.

7. Additional Terms

Bonuses and Promotions:

  • Bonuses are offered at Formula Fanatics' discretion and communicated prior to the bonus period.

  • Eligibility rules for bonuses will be provided before the bonus period begins.

Intellectual Property:

  • Affiliates may use Formula Fanatics’ logos, images, and content as provided.

  • There are no restrictions on modifying or repurposing approved content.

Legal Compliance:

  • Affiliates must comply with FTC disclosure guidelines and all applicable laws and regulations.

  • Disputes will be handled according to industry standards.

8. Technical Details

Tracking and Attribution:

  • Referrals are tracked using affiliate codes and discount codes.

  • Cookie duration: 45 days.

Policy Updates:

  • Terms and conditions are subject to change without notice.

Thank you for being a part of the Formula Fanatics Affiliate Program. For questions or support, please contact our team at [support@formulafanatics.com]. We look forward to a successful partnership!
